mechanism: Methylprednisolone causes hypokalemia through increased renal potassium excretion via mineralocorticoid effects and sodium reabsorption in the distal tubule, necessitating potassium supplementation monitoring.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; consider potassium supplementation during methylprednisolone therapy; assess for hypokalemia symptoms (muscle weakness, arrhythmias).
